_comment: Today in Disney History. Key = MM-DD. Priority: (1) Walt Disney World milestones, (2) other Disney park milestones, (3) major Walt Disney personal facts. Only well-documented dates are included. Missing days fall back to a dateless evergreen line (see fetch_data.py) so the frame NEVER shows another day's fact as if it were today. Keep blurb <= ~180 chars to fit the card.
